name: InkMantle
tagline: Enterprise-grade booking infrastructure for independent tattoo studios.
positioning: InkMantle standardizes deposits, consent forms, and artist calendars into one operational system built for owner-operated tattoo studios.

hero.h1: Run your tattoo studio like a real operation.
hero.sub: InkMantle unifies deposits, consent forms, and per-artist calendars into a single booking system — so owner-operators stop losing revenue to no-shows and spreadsheet chaos.

features.title: Deposit enforcement, automated
features.description: Require and collect non-refundable deposits at booking, with configurable forfeit rules per artist. Reconcile every session against your payout ledger.

features.title: Compliant consent capture
features.description: Digital consent and aftercare forms are signed before the chair, timestamped, and archived per client for audit and liability requirements.

features.title: Per-artist calendars
features.description: Each artist gets an isolated availability calendar, buffer rules, and flash-booking rates that sync to one studio-wide operational view.

features.title: No-show recovery
features.description: Automated reminder sequences and rebooking flows recapture cancelled slots and cut idle chair time across every seat you operate.

features.title: Revenue reporting
features.description: Track deposits, tips, and completed sessions by artist, day, and style. Export clean statements for accounting and quarterly reviews.

features.title: Client records
features.description: Every client's history, healed photos, and outstanding balances live in one profile your front desk can pull up in seconds.

testimonials.quote: We were juggling three apps and a paper deposit book. InkMantle consolidated all of it — no-shows dropped 34% in our first quarter because deposits actually stick now.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delgado

testimonials.quote: Onboarding six artists onto shared calendars used to take a week of friction. Now every seat is booked and reconciled without me chasing anyone for their numbers.
testimonials.name: Priya Novak

testimonials.quote: The consent archive alone was worth it. When an insurer asked for signed forms, I exported two years of records in under a minute.
testimonials.name: Devon Whitaker
